sentences.text:
V/S
State of Punjab and another ....Respondents
Coram : Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Namit Kumar

Present: Mr. Kuldip Singh, Advocate for the petitioner.
 Mr. Adhiraj Singh, A.A.G., Punjab.
 Mr. R.K. Kachuza, Advocate for respondent No.2.
 ****
Namit Kumar, J. (Oral)
1.

The petitioner has filed the instant petition under Section 528 of Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha
Sanhita, 2023 seeking quashing of Fir No.66 dated 09.06.2024 registered under Section 376 of
Indian Penal Code, 1860 at Police Station Vairo Ke, District Fazilka (Annexure P-1) along with all
consequential proceedings arising therefrom on the basis of compromise dated 30.01.2025
(Annexure P-2).

2. Learned State counsel, on instructions from ASI Mahender Singh, submits that cancellation report has been prepared on 19.06.2025 and is pending approval before the Senior Superintendent of Police, Fazilka.
3. In this view of the matter, learned counsel for the petitioner wishes to withdraw the present petition with liberty to avail other legal remedies in accordance with law.
4. Dismissed as withdrawn with liberty aforesaid.
